definitions.explanation: Irregular, unpredictable movements in the atmosphere that cause sudden jolting and shaking of aircraft during flight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱気流|らんきりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧。
examples.english: The airplane was caught in turbulence.

examples.japanese: {乱気流|らんきりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦シートベルト→シートベルト：29083_shiitoberuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}めて→締める：10057_shimeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fasten your seatbelts due to turbulence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{乱気流|らんきりゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{機内|きない}→機内：18819_kinai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Passengers inside the plane were injured by severe turbulence.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in aviation contexts. Compound of {乱|らん} (chaotic), ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (air), and {流|りゅう} (flow). Also used metaphorically to describe chaotic or turbulent situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乱気流|らんきりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ (to be caught in turbulence)
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{乱気流|らんきりゅう} (severe turbulence)
- {乱気流|らんきりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧ (turbulence occurs)
- {乱気流|らんきりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧ (to encounter turbulence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- タービュランス: turbulence (loanword) — used in technical/aviation English contexts
- ⟦{気流|きりゅう}→気流：27360_kiryuu⟧: air current — the neutral base term without the "chaotic" element
